benchmarks.name: XTC-Bench generation (Overall Gen., scene-graph node agreement)

setup.metric: Overall Gen.: how well the image generated from a scene-graph-derived prompt recovers the scene-graph nodes (objects, attributes, relations) over all nodes, continuous 0-1.
setup.protocol: XTC-Bench derives generation prompts and understanding queries from the same structured scene graphs (COCO-based); generated images are parsed into scene graphs and matched to the reference with an LLM judge; Table 2 reports node-level generation quality. Eight open-source unified multimodal models run by the authors.
setup.limitations: Single LLM-judge pipeline; model checkpoints/resolutions not detailed in the main text; CCTA and understanding columns not recorded.

benchmarks.name: MixInstruct GPT-Rank (LLM-Blender, mean rank among 11 instruction-tuned LLMs, ChatGPT pairwise judge)

setup.metric: GPT-Rank: each example's 11 candidate answers are ranked via ChatGPT pairwise comparisons (MaxWins aggregation); a model's score is its mean rank over examples (1 = best, 11 = worst).
setup.protocol: Eleven open instruction-following LLMs answer 100K MixInstruct prompts (Alpaca-GPT4, Dolly-15K, GPT4All-LAION, ShareGPT); ChatGPT compares all candidate pairs on the 4,771 test examples; checkpoints listed on the dataset card.
setup.limitations: Rank is pool-relative (11 models, mostly 2023 open models) and judged by ChatGPT; scale 1 = one rank position.

benchmarks.name: VMMU (Vietnamese multimodal understanding and reasoning, mean accuracy over 7 tasks)

setup.metric: Mean accuracy over the seven task columns of Table 2 (Math, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Geography, Driving-license, IQ), stored as a fraction.
setup.protocol: 2.5k Vietnamese multimodal questions in 7 tasks; each question requires combining the image and text (no OCR/text-only shortcuts); models prompted with the paper's fixed prompt (Figs. 9-10); the paper prints a random-answer baseline row (mean 25.92%).
setup.limitations: Single prompt, API/open-weight inference settings not detailed; random baseline is 25.92% over the seven tasks (stored chance 0.2592).

benchmarks.name: Medmarks-V mean win rate (19 verifiable medical benchmarks, 71 configurations)

setup.version: Medmarks-V as run in arXiv 2605.01417v1 (61 models, 71 configurations)
setup.metric: Weighted mean win rate: for each of the 19 verifiable benchmarks a model's win rate is its share of pairwise wins against the other configurations; benchmarks are combined with log-size weights (appendix H).
setup.protocol: Open-source evaluation suite built on the verifiers library; open-weight models run on vLLM, API models through a gateway; each model evaluated with its officially recommended sampling parameters.
setup.limitations: Pool-relative (win rate against the 71-configuration pool), so scores shift if the pool changes; latent_scale 0.08 is the standard deviation (0.081) of the 71 published win rates (mean 0.50).

benchmarks.name: Cosmos 3D consistency: camera-pose estimation success rate on generated videos

setup.metric: Share of generated videos on which a structure-from-motion/pose estimator succeeds (higher = more geometrically consistent), stored as a fraction.
setup.protocol: NVIDIA's evaluation of base Cosmos models on 3D consistency (Sec. 5.2): videos generated from DAVIS-style prompts are reconstructed with a pose estimator; success rate and epipolar (Sampson) error are reported alongside view-synthesis metrics.
setup.limitations: Maker-run, four NVIDIA models only (plus VideoLDM and real-video reference rows not recorded); estimator and prompt set as in the paper.

benchmarks.name: Cosmos 3D consistency: Sampson epipolar error on generated videos (lower is better)

setup.metric: Mean Sampson (epipolar) error of correspondences between frames of the generated video; lower means more geometrically consistent.
setup.protocol: As cosmos-3d-pose-success: same videos, same table (Table 19).
setup.limitations: Raw error units; linear scale 0.1; four NVIDIA models only.

benchmarks.name: Kaleidoscope (in-language multimodal exams, 18 languages, overall accuracy)

setup.metric: Overall accuracy (Acc.) over all Kaleidoscope questions (multimodal and text-only), format errors counted as incorrect; stored as a fraction.
setup.protocol: 20,911 multiple-choice exam questions in 18 languages (55% need the image); zero-shot, answer extracted from <ANSWER> tags; open-weight models run locally with temperature 0.7, max 1024 tokens, 512x512 images; closed models use chain-of-thought prompts.
setup.limitations: Single prompt format; option counts vary by question so random-guess chance is not a single number (chance stored as 0).

benchmarks.name: Factual knowledge recall, Premium2k exact match (zero-shot)

setup.metric: Exact-match accuracy (zero-shot) on the 2,000-question Premium2k subset (fact-recall questions generated from Wikidata triplets with Wikipedia-grounded answers), stored as a fraction.
setup.protocol: 15k evaluation questions across 20 relation types, Premium2k = a 2k subset with manually verified, specific questions; zero-shot or 10-shot prompts per the paper's Tables 5-7; EM against the answer or its Wikidata aliases.
setup.limitations: Questions generated with Claude v1.3; sampling and API snapshots (July 2023) as in the paper; EM only (the 'Contains' column is not recorded).

benchmarks.name: CVTG-500L PNED (English long-prompt text rendering, Cosmos 3 report)

setup.metric: PNED: OCR-extracted text matched to target strings per region by Hungarian matching on normalised edit distance, English long-prompt set of 500 prompts; stored as a fraction.
setup.protocol: 500 prompts sampled from CVTG-2K (Du et al. 2025), each upsampled into a long dense description; OCR then PNED/GNED scoring (Sec. 6.2).
setup.limitations: Maker-run (NVIDIA) comparison of Cosmos 3 against open and closed models in one table; custom prompt sets (CVTG-500L, CVTG-102ch) are specific to the Cosmos 3 report.

benchmarks.name: CVTG-102ch PNED (Chinese character rendering, Cosmos 3 report)

setup.protocol: 102 NVIDIA-written prompts covering public spaces, outdoor scenes and digital displays; OCR + PNED as for CVTG-500L.

benchmarks.name: HPSv3 score of Cosmos 3 report text-to-image evaluation images

setup.protocol: Images generated by each model for the report's T2I prompts and scored by HPSv3.
setup.limitations: Maker-run (NVIDIA) comparison of Cosmos 3 against open and closed models in one table; custom prompt sets (CVTG-500L, CVTG-102ch) are specific to the Cosmos 3 report.

benchmarks.name: CodeReviewQA: automated code refinement, exact match rate

setup.metric: Overall exact-match rate (%) of the model's refined code against the human-refined reference over nine programming languages; stored as a fraction.
setup.protocol: CodeReviewQA (9 languages, review comments with code); zero-shot greedy generation, exact match after normalisation.
setup.limitations: Greedy single run; models listed in the paper's Table 7 only.

benchmarks.name: CodeReviewQA: change type recognition, invariant accuracy

setup.metric: Invariant accuracy (%) on the change-type-recognition multiple-choice probe: a question counts only if the model picks the right answer under every ordering of the options; stored as a fraction.
setup.protocol: MCQA probes derived from the same code-review items as the refinement task; log-probability ranking of the option symbols for every option ordering; zero-shot.
setup.limitations: Invariant accuracy is stricter than plain accuracy (chance is below 1/N, stored 0).
